working_shown.description: One physical event - a ball thrown at 3.0 m/s and 60 degrees, two bodies of mass 1.8 and 1.1 on a Kepler ellipse about their barycentre, or a pendulum released from 0.5 rad - computed in closed form and frozen at seven-tenths of its own window, then presented under each of the evidence family's four rungs with the working made of geometry: the trace as a real tube along the path, the longhand as the body stamped at equal time-steps and rods whose lengths are the velocity, the acceleration, the separation and the mass, the axiom as a minimal built diagram of the law (an L of rulers for the throw and the swing, identical by construction; the inverse-square flux figure for the attraction) with the body gone. No chart, no HUD; the only numerals are two masses on their rings.

dna.default: evidence=result, event=throw. result is the default of 18 of the 32 promoted members (longhand 9, trace 5); it is the visitor's rung and it is where the family opens, so the synthesis opens there too. A SYNTHESIS HAS NO SHIPPED PLACEMENTS, so event is a free design choice: throw, because its result variant is the WIDEST single frame in the twelve (a 0.895 m rail against the attraction's 0.41 m and the swing's 0.21 m at rest), so a framing solved on the default is a framing that holds the others; because its longhand carries the family's clearest single device (example_1_8's equal time, growing gap); and because its law is the one the designed null rests on.
dna.note:
THE CENSUS, counted from the registry on 2026-08-15 and not from the brief (which said 28): 41 artifacts declare an axis `evidence` in the vocabulary result / trace / longhand / axiom. 32 are promoted members, 26 with all four words and 6 with three (calder_mobile, calder_object_mobile, ftc_bridge, weather_vector_field, zeno_staircase stop at longhand; rotation_gimbal has result/longhand/axiom): bouncing_ball, branching_vine, calder_mobile, calder_object_mobile, control_pendulum, dark_side_prism, example_1_7_motion_101_velocity_vr, example_1_8_motion_101_velocity_and_constant_acceleration_vr, example_1_9_motion_101_velocity_and_random_acceleration_vr, example_2_3_gravity_scaled_by_mass_vr, example_2_8_two_body_attraction_vr, example_2_9_n_body_attraction_vr, example_3_3_pointing_in_the_direction_of_motion_vr, exercise_1_3_solution_3_d_bouncing_ball_vr, exercise_1_5_solution_accelerate_and_decelerate_vr, exercise_1_8_solution_attraction_magnitude_vr, ftc_bridge, gradient_descent_visualization, gradient_hunter, lissajous_curves, lsystem_tree, nbody_simulation, newtons_laws, pixel_cloud, pythagorean_triangle_angles, rotation_gimbal, simulated_annealing, slope_tangent_demo, three_body_problem, velocity_arrow, weather_vector_field, zeno_staircase. 4 declare it unpromoted: box_counting_dimension, fibonacci_sequences, koch_curve, sine_wave_controller. 5 are earlier syntheses of the same word: boundary_tank, chapter_arc, generator_bench, noise_quarry, selection_garden. Categories of the 32: physics 8, unknown 8 (all of them NOC forces and vectors examples, i.e. physics), change 4, vectors 3, algorithms 2, waves 2, hazards 2, procedural 2, transforms 1 - so `physics`. Seven members' code was read: example_2_8_two_body_attraction_vr, example_2_3_gravity_scaled_by_mass_vr, example_1_8_motion_101_velocity_and_constant_acceleration_vr, control_pendulum, calder_mobile, branching_vine, box_counting_dimension.

WHAT THE FAMILY'S RUNGS DO, from the code. example_2_8: result = the shipped resultant arrows; trace = the arrows go and both orbits are integrated forward and laid down as dotted paths ('the future drawn before it happens'); longhand = the arrows go, r is a graduated rod between the bodies with a tick every 5 cm and each body wears a ring whose AREA is its mass; axiom = a slate behind the bodies with F = G m1 m2 / r^2 and the 1/r^2 curve, the bodies keep orbiting in front 'demoted from the subject to an instance'. example_2_3: result = one weight arrow per body (m g, which differs); trace = arrows off, three dotted columns with rungs at equal heights; longhand = arrows KEPT plus a second arrow of identical length (the acceleration, after the division) and a mass ring; axiom = arrows off, slate with F = m g, a = F / m = g. example_1_8: result = the pink ball and the slider; trace = the whole flight as a line strip; longhand = the invisible tank drawn, a and v as arrows magnified x20 / x4, and the first fall stamped every 8 steps - 'equal time, growing gap'; axiom = a plate with v += a, p += v, the second-difference statement, and a ruler of n-squared ticks under it. control_pendulum: result = nothing added; trace = theta(t) plotted with its zero line; longhand = that plus zeta, omega0 and T as numbers; axiom = the equation of motion and T = 2 pi sqrt(L / g) on a slate WITH NO CURVE. calder_mobile: result = the sculpture; trace = gram tags on the leaves; longhand = the tags and the plaque with the total - the one strict ladder among the seven. branching_vine: result = the vine at whatever generation the timer reached; trace = the earlier generations ghosted inside it at one root; longhand = every generation side by side at one scale; axiom = ONE application of F -> F[+F][-F]F, the vine itself not drawn. box_counting_dimension: result = cloud, one grid, the log-log plot and D printed; trace = all six coverings stacked; longhand = one covering with every occupied cell filled; axiom = grid, plot, tags and readout ALL MUTED, the gasket alone.

THE THESIS SOMEONE COULD DISAGREE WITH. `evidence` is not how MUCH working is shown; it is WHO is being shown, and the proof is that in the family's own code the rungs refuse to nest. Only calder_mobile is a ladder. control_pendulum drops the curve at axiom, example_2_8 hides its answer at every rung above result, example_2_3 hides it at two of three, box_counting_dimension's top rung shows less than its bottom one, and branching_vine's replaces the instance with the rule. So each rung is a different witness put in the invisible force's place: the outcome (visitor), the path (student), the steps and quantities (examiner), the law (sceptic) - and the sceptic is shown the least of the instance. The disagreement available: the family ORDERS the words result < trace < longhand < axiom, and an order is a claim of quantity; on that reading the non-nesting members are lazy and this artifact has built the laziness. The artifact takes the non-nesting side and builds it: longhand does not carry the tube, and axiom carries no body at all.

WHAT THE VALUES MEAN HERE. evidence, four values in the family's order: result = the outcome - the fixture (a rail whose length is the range with a release mark; a barycentre post; a pivot bar) and the body or bodies at the frozen moment, nothing of how they got there; the default of 18 of the 32 promoted members. trace = the outcome plus the PATH: the tube the body's centre draws over the whole window, past and future, 6 mm radius, in the body's own colour lightened, laid down in space (the swing's is sampled over the half period that covers its arc once, because the second half retreads it). longhand = the outcome plus the WORKING and NOT the path: the body stamped translucent at every tenth of the window from release up to the frozen moment (the frozen body is the last stamp of the row - the eighth in the throw and the attraction, the seventh in the swing, where a stamp that lands on an earlier one past the far turning point is not drawn twice), and at the frozen body the quantities as rods whose lengths ARE the quantities at ONE scale for all events, 0.10 m per m/s of velocity (sky) and 0.02 m per m/s^2 of acceleration (amber): throw = v0 at the release and v at the ball, each with its horizontal and vertical components as thinner rods closing a rectangle (the horizontal one the same length at both, which is the whole of the first law), and g down from the ball; attraction = the separation rod graduated every 5 cm, a ring on each body whose area is its mass (0.07 sqrt m) with the mass as a numeral on the ring - the only text in the artifact, because a mass is the one quantity here that has no length - the acceleration of each body toward the other (G m_other / r^2, equal and opposite as forces, unequal as accelerations), and each body's velocity; swing = the rod graduated every 5 cm from the pivot, g down from the bob with its two components (along the rod, and along the tangent - the restoring part) closing a parallelogram, and the velocity along the tangent. axiom = the LAW alone: fixture and bodies gone, a minimal built diagram of the rule where they stood - for the throw and the swing the L of rulers (a 0.72 m horizontal rule with 12 equal ticks and a 0.36 m vertical rule with ticks at n^2 for n = 1..6, sharing the top-left corner: uniform motion across and s = 1/2 g t^2 down for the throw, Galileo's composition, which example_1_8 draws as its n-squared rule; T across and L = (g / 4 pi^2) T^2 down for the swing, control_pendulum's slate's second line), drawn as ONE figure so that throw + axiom and swing + axiom are identical to the byte; for the attraction the flux figure - an apex, one 0.11 m tile at 0.22 m, four at 0.44, nine at 0.66, in planes facing the apex, and four rods from the apex to the far grid's corners: what goes through one tile at r goes through four at 2r, the inverse square with no curve and no text.

event, three values, every one closed-form and frozen at seven-tenths of its own window (a fraction, so the ball is descending, the pair is one fifth past periapsis, and the bob is near the bottom and rising - velocity and force non-zero and non-parallel in all three, which the longhand needs): throw = one ball of radius 0.035 launched at 3.0 m/s and 60 degrees under g = 9.8 from the left end of a rail, range v0^2 sin 2a / g = 0.795 m, flight 2 v0 sin a / g = 0.530 s, apex 0.344 m; frozen at 0.371 s at (0.159, 0.324) with v = (1.50, -1.04); position by the closed form of example_1_8's v += a, p += v. attraction = two bodies of example_2_8's masses 1.8 and 1.1 (gd:155-156) and radii 0.03 + 0.01 m (gd:190) about a barycentre post at x = 0, on a Kepler ellipse of eccentricity 0.5 released from rest at apoapsis 0.70 m apart (the heavy body at +0.266, the light one at -0.434), a = 0.467, mu = G (m1 + m2) with G = 1.0 rather than the member's 0.4 (see `declines`), period 1.176 s, position by Kepler's equation E - e sin E = M solved by Newton and not by stepping; frozen at 0.823 s with the bodies 0.508 m apart at (0.120, 0.199) and (-0.196, 0.597), speeds 0.87 and 1.42 m/s. swing = a pendulum of control_pendulum's g (gd:69) and rod-to-bob ratio (gd:67-68), L = 0.55, bob 0.05, pivot at 0.63 m, released from 0.5 rad rather than its 0.3 (gd:84) so the arc is a third of the frame; theta = 0.5 cos(omega0 t), omega0 = sqrt(g / L) = 4.22 rad/s, period 1.489 s in the linear closed form (about 1.6% short of the true period at this amplitude, T(theta0) / T0 = 1 + theta0^2 / 16); frozen at 1.042 s at theta = -0.155 rad, theta-dot = +2.01 rad/s, |v| = 1.10 m/s. The check the event axis exists to pass: the same rung must read the same across all three - a tube, a strobe row with rods, an L or a cone of tiles - and does; the one place events stop being different is the sceptic's rung, by design.

predicted_degeneracy.pair: trace against result, in the swing event
predicted_degeneracy.arithmetic: Enumerated over all 12 variants with a front-view orthographic raster of the planned geometry (2.5 mm pixels, 480 x 320 px = a 1.20 x 0.80 m frame, silhouette XOR / union, no shading, no antialiasing) before any capture. Every evidence pair on this artifact differs by a whole class of object, so the closest one is the pair whose added object is thinnest: the swing's trace, an arc tube of radius 6 mm along 2 x 0.55 x 0.5 = 0.55 rad of arc, i.e. 0.55 x 0.55 = 0.30 m of path minus the 0.10 m the bob covers, at 12 mm wide = about 0.0025 m^2 by hand, 0.0054 m^2 by the raster with the tube's own antialiasing pad; on a result silhouette of 0.0178 m^2 that is 23.4% of the pair's union subject and 0.57% of the 0.96 m^2 raster frame. Registered at 0.6% of frame. Runners-up from the same table: result against trace in the throw event 45% of union / 1.30% of frame (the parabola tube is 1.0 m of path); result against trace in the attraction 63% / 3.07% (two closed ellipses, 1.5 m of tube); trace against longhand in the swing 73% / 6.1%. Every pair involving axiom is 97-100% of union because axiom shares nothing with the other three but empty space. THIS IS A FLOOR: wave 14's four rasters under-predicted by 1.5x to 6.7x, and this one cannot see the emissive tube's glow, shading or the oblique standpoint (yaw 0.62 shortens the arc's chord to about 81% and adds nothing else, so the standpoint pushes the pair DOWN, not up). The percentage scales with 0.96 m^2 / (the sweep's frame area): if the solved frame is 1.2 m square the same difference is 0.38%. If it comes back under about 0.3% the tube is being lost in the bob or in the frame and the swing's arc, not the axis, is at fault; if the closest pair is NOT a result-trace pair at all, the raster's model of what the tube adds is wrong and the pair to look at is trace against longhand in the swing, where the ghost stamps sit ON the tube's path and share its pixels.

designed_nulls.why: Identical by construction: _add_axiom calls _axiom_rulers for both, which draws the same L of rulers from the same constants (AX_CORNER, AX_W, AX_H, AX_TICKS, AX_SQ) with no reference to the event, and axiom draws no fixture and no body. It is the thesis in one pair: the throw rests on s = 1/2 g t^2 and the swing on L = (g / 4 pi^2) T^2, length as g times time squared in both, so at the sceptic's rung the two events are one figure. If this pair comes back above 0.1% something in the sweep is not the axis - a per-variant framing, an unseeded material, a stale scene - and the run should stop there. It is also the pair a critic will report as the event axis being INERT at axiom, which it is, on purpose; the attraction's axiom against either is 97% of union / 2.6% of frame in the raster.

dna.fixture_why: The artifact can stand as all four rungs in a row (layout = ladder, 1.10 m pitch, about 4.2 m wide) but the SWEEP must see one rung at a time: capture_config_sweep unions the AABB across a spec's variants, so a four-wide row in the same spec frames every single rung against four metres and photographs it as a speck. layout is an export and not an axis, it ships at single, and the fixture is a belt over braces.
dna.kin: The same word `evidence` is declared in two OTHER vocabularies, which are kin and not subject: census / sample / anecdote / none (distribution_sampler, distribution_comparator, galton_board, shannon_workbench - what a distribution offers as proof of itself), and result / trace / sources / longhand (force_field_visualizer, wave_interference_tank, wave_interference, wave_interference_3d, DualBallFMController - where `sources` names the addends of a superposition; boundary_tank's registry argues that rung out for its own subject). Neither list is offered here: this artifact has no population and nothing is being summed.
declines: AN ALL-RUNGS VALUE INSIDE `evidence`. The four rungs can stand in a row (layout = ladder, 1.10 m pitch, about 4.2 m wide) but that is an @export `layout` outside both axes, pinned to single by the fixture: wave 13's speck.

THE MEMBER'S G. example_2_8 runs G = 0.4 in a 0.8 m tank at 60 Hz. At 0.4 with these masses and this ellipse the accelerations at the frozen moment are 1.7 and 2.8 m/s^2, which at the shared 0.02 m per m/s^2 is 3.4 and 5.6 cm of rod beside the throw's and swing's 19.6 cm of g. The scale is shared across events on purpose (a rod is a length you can compare across the axis), so the constant moved instead: G = 1.0, accelerations 4.3 and 7.0 m/s^2, rods 8.5 and 14 cm. What is kept from the member is the pair of masses, the body radii and the shape of the law.

KEEPING THE BODY AT AXIOM. Four of the seven members read keep their instance under the law (example_2_8, example_2_3, example_1_8, control_pendulum) - and all four are LIVE demos whose subject cannot be switched off. Two replace the instance with the rule (branching_vine, lsystem_tree by the same code) and one strips everything but the object (box_counting_dimension). Frozen, there is nothing that must keep running, and the reading that carries the argument - the sceptic is shown the least of the instance - is the one built. This is a deviation from the brief, which asked for the event presented under every rung; the code was split and the split was resolved toward the thesis.

A `fall` EVENT (example_2_3's three masses dropped together). Considered and not built: it is a comparison of three bodies rather than one event, its trace is three vertical lines, and its axiom (a = F / m = g) is the throw's vertical ruler alone. example_2_3 stands in the sources for its longhand devices (the mass ring whose area is mass, the acceleration arrow that does not scale with the weight), which the attraction's and the swing's longhand use.

THE EXACT PENDULUM. theta(t) at 0.5 rad is a Jacobi elliptic function; the linear cosine is used and the 1.6% period error is stated rather than hidden. control_pendulum integrates sin theta at the physics tick; this artifact does not step, by rule, so it linearises.
dna.framing_why: SOLVED, NOT GUESSED, by tools/solve_framing.py. At framing 1.0 this artifact's subject bounding box filled 41.2% of frame width and 23.8% of its height, with a subject share of 0.92%. The visible frame is 2 * PAD * radius * framing metres wide, so the box grows as 1/framing; solving for a target of 78% of the smaller-headroom dimension gives 0.53. THE ARTIFACT WAS NEVER DARK, EMPTY OR MISSING A FIXTURE - the camera was between three and eight times too far away, and the near-zero subject share this token had on record was a fact about the standpoint rather than about the axis.
